# Instructions for agents

**This repository is archived (October 27, 2026). Do not edit it, branch from it, or sync it into Studio.**

The game now lives only in the Roblox Studio place `123038652032080`, edited directly in Studio. Theodore decided to stop using Rojo. This repo is a frozen snapshot of the code as it was when the switch happened.

To work on the game:

1. Open the place in Roblox Studio and read `ServerStorage.README` (the script map and the working rules).
2. Read the current handoff in seawind-ideas: `ideas/co-op-pegboard-adventure/research/2026-10-27-game-state-handoff.md`.
3. Read the current [Seawind handbook](https://github.com/Tedwardo6/seawind-handbook) main (WORKSPACES.md and the relevant chapters) and record its commit.
4. Edit scripts in Studio, test in Play, save with File > Save to Roblox, and update the handoff when you stop.

The old Rojo-era instructions are in this file's Git history (commit `22df78e`).
